description: This file contains unit tests for the ControlService component, verifying behaviors such as acknowledgment, application state setting, control addition/removal, and ping functionality.

methods.name: shouldNotAckWithoutAddedControl
methods.description: Verifies that acknowledgment is false if control has not been added.

methods.name: shouldNotSetApplicationStateWithoutAddedControl
methods.description: Verifies that setting application state does not occur without a control being added.

methods.name: shouldNotAckWithUnknownControlId
methods.description: Checks that acknowledgment fails for an unknown control ID.

methods.name: shouldNotAckWithRemovedControlId
methods.description: Ensures acknowledgment fails if the control has been removed.

methods.name: shouldNotSetApplicationStateWithRemovedControlId
methods.description: Verifies that setting application state fails if the control has been removed.

methods.name: shouldAck
methods.description: Checks that acknowledgment succeeds when control is properly added and acknowledged.

methods.name: shouldSetApplicationState
methods.description: Verifies that application state can be set for an added control.

methods.name: shouldSetApplicationStateForNewControl
methods.description: Ensures application state can be set immediately after creating a new control.

methods.name: shouldPing
methods.description: Verifies that the ping operation works correctly for the control.
